source: TESTING §7.2 case bsm.zero.vol: call = max(S*e^(-qT) - K*e^(-rT), 0) = 4.877058 at tolerance 1e-9, gamma = 0, vega = 0, no NaN anywhere. 4.877057549928594 IS that pinned value, evaluated in CPython at full double precision — the 4.877058 printed in TESTING is the same number rounded to six decimals, and a 1e-9 tolerance can only be applied to the unrounded one (the rounded literal is 4.5e-7 away, the same trap TESTING §7.2 assertion 7 documents for the implied-vol round trip). The test asserts both: 1e-6 against the printed 4.877058 and 1e-9 against the closed form.
